To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the accounting benefits of an ERP system, particularly the ones related to accounting process and accounting information, have a positive effect on the ERP user satisfaction of accountants.
the adoption of ERP systems has had a positive effect on accounting information and accounting practice.
the ERP accounting benefits and user satisfaction are positively related and the accounting benefits are greater for accounting users than for IT users.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the accounting benefits of an ERP system implementation in terms of the accounting process, the accounting system, and the accounting information and how these accounting benefits are related to ERP user satisfaction.
the accounting benefits and satisfaction that can occur from the adoption of an Enterprise Resource Planning system in Greece.
the benefits of ERP adoption for the accounting function and the relationship between accounting benefits and satisfaction of ERP system users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ERP systems have a significant impact on accounting and that this effect can be measured and quantified.
the accounting benefits derived from an ERP implementation can be considered to be significant.
ERP systems have a number of accounting advantages and that the level of ERP accounting benefits is positively related with ERP user satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the accounting benefits of an ERP system implementation are not the same for all companies, and that there is a positive correlation between accounting benefits and the ERP user satisfaction of the accounting department.
the adoption of ERP systems in organizations is a complex process that has both positive and negative impacts on the organization.
the accounting benefits of ERP systems are significant for accounting information and practice and that the level of user satisfaction with ERP systems is affected by accounting related factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
accounting benefits are a significant factor in ERP user satisfaction and that accounting benefits are more important than ERP user satisfaction.
ERP user satisfaction has an effect on accounting benefits.
ERP system adoption has a significant impact on accounting information and process.
